segments.text:
V. 32.
They repented at the preaching of Jonah—But it was only for a Seaſon. Afterwards they relapſed into Wickedneſs, till (after about forty Years) they were deſtroyed. It is remarkable, that in this alſo the Compariſon held. GOD reprieved the Jews for about forty Years: But they ſtill advanced in Wickedneſs, till having filled up their Meaſure, they were deſtroyed with an utter Deſtruction.
